text:
Evan: Quick thread to finalise release note + internal announce for v1.13.0 (schema tweak + optimizer changes). Need a pin and communication plan.
Tara: prefer low-traffic window tomorrow 02:00 PT. Canary at 01:30, ramp 02:00.
Simone: agree on off-peak. The optimizer change may increase CPU briefly during warmup; recommend canary 2% and a 10m observation pause before ramp.
Evan: can we pin to build tag rel-1.13.0-pinA? That way ops can instantly rollback to an exact artifact.
deploybot: @Evan pin applied: rel-1.13.0-pinA. Canary scheduled 1769999400 (01:30 PT). Full rollout scheduled 1769999900 (02:00 PT). Canary percent: 2%.
Tara: internal announce cadence: T-90m to #eng-oncall with runbook + rollback CLI; T-30m to #eng with heads-up; T+1h company-wide note summarising any visible effects.
Simone: rollback criteria proposal: sustained p95 increase >250ms for 10m OR error-rate increase >1.5% for 5m OR CPU > 88% on app-nodes for 5m. If any trigger, ops should run rollback.
Evan: add DB condition: migration lock wait >120s for 3m — immediate rollback.
ops-bot: scheduled backup snapshot at 1769999400 (01:30 PT). Will pause non-essential background jobs at 1769999600 (01:40 PT).
Tara: legal check? Any user-facing text needing review?
Legal: no user-data changes. No legal hold.
Evan: draft for ops note (short): "Planned deploy v1.13.0 (optimizer + schema). Canary 01:30 PT, rollout 02:00 PT. Watch p95, error rate, CPU, and DB lock waits. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/v1.13.0-migration. Rollback: see snippet."
Simone: ops rollback snippet to include CLI example and exact target tag:
```
# ops rollback
deploybot rollback --to rel-1.12.5-stable --reason "metric_trigger_or_manual"
```
Tara: CI artifact retention for pinned builds? Keep for 10 days? We'll need binaries for forensics if we roll back.
deploybot: artifact retention set to 10 days for pin rel-1.13.0-pinA.
Evan: also add a short FAQ line in the internal note: "Why pin? Pins let ops rollback to a known-good binary immediately and preserve artifacts for debugging."
Tara: who posts the T-90m ops note? I can post to #eng-oncall. Evan will tag @Simone and @Tara for live monitoring.
Simone: I'll be on-call for the window. Also will enable extra tracing for the warmup period and monitor the new optimizer metric.
Evan: final checks: pin applied, canary 2%, backup/snapshot scheduled, runbook link included, artifact retention 10d, rollback criteria documented. If no objections I'll mark the release note draft as "internal-ready" and queue the T-90m post.
Tara: no objections from me. :+1:
Simone: ack.
ops-bot: Reminder: please ensure on-call rota coverage and keep escalation contact list up to date.
deploybot: Note: pinned build artifacts will be accessible in Console under Releases > Pins for 10 days. Canary heartbeat set to 60s.
Evan: great. Closing draft. I'll paste the final ops snippet in 5m and flip the doc to ready.
